differences.a_observable: The white blocks have a distinct cool blue color cast under the studio lighting.
differences.b_observable: The white blocks are neutral grey with no blue color cast.
differences.fix: Add a cool blue light source or adjust the white balance to introduce a blue color cast to the scene.

differences.a_observable: The blocks exhibit a glossy finish with subtle specular highlights along their rounded edges.
differences.b_observable: The blocks are matte with flat shading and no specular highlights on the edges.
differences.fix: Increase the specularity and lower the roughness of the block material to catch highlights.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a dynamic perspective angle relative to the three vertical blocks.
differences.b_observable: The camera angle is flatter and more front-on, reducing the perspective depth.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera focal length and position to match the perspective angle of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The Recurly block has a warm, golden-yellow hue.
differences.b_observable: The Recurly block has a cooler, greenish-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the diffuse color of the Recurly block to match the golden-yellow hue of the reference.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the lighting color temperature and block material properties to match the cool blue cast and glossy specular highlights of the reference.
